analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($318.71) vs SMA5 ($353.31)/SMA20 ($391.78)/SMA50 ($422.11): trading below, indicating a bearish short-to-medium term trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($419.96)/SMA200 ($402.25): suggesting weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (21.3%) + current price level is near historical lows within the 52-week range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.3 → 28.3): continuing in oversold territory with strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6436 → -5.8482): worsening trend, signaling continued bearish pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $330.07): approaching the lower band, with a band width of 31.50% indicating increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($313.80): 5-day low ($318.48) broken, suggesting potential downside break of support.
· Swing resistance ($350.45): significant distance from current price, acting as the first resistance level on any short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Lower High, 5-day low updated): confirming continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.17x 5-day average): sharp increase suggesting heightened selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): consider buying only after RSI exits oversold and MACD reverses; for selling, maintain a wait-and-see approach as the trend persists.
